transcription: This small room, a lonely view, grey skies over Shibuya, raindrops on the window pane, a familiar, soft refrain, whispering your name again, across the miles, across the pane. Tokyo lights begin to gleam, lost inside a waking dream, every drop of memory of you, so far from me. Oh, the city rain falls down, on this quiet Tokyo town, each drop of tear I can't explain, wishing you were here again, my heart aches with this sweet, sad strain. Neon signs and blurry streaks, reflecting on the wet streets, umbrellas pass a hurry pace, no one sees my lonely face, lost in time, lost in this place, searching for your gentle grace. Tokyo lights begin to gleam, lost inside a waking dream, every drop of memory of you, so far from me. Oh, the city rain falls down, on this quiet Tokyo town, each drop of tear I can't explain, wishing you were here again, my heart aches with this sweet, sad strain. The piano plays a soft lemon, a gentle, mournful sentiment, my acoustic guitar weeps low, where did our happy moments go, this longing, it continues to grow. Empty chair beside me now, I trace your smile upon my brow, this apartment feels so vast, shadows from a fading past, how long will this feeling last? My anchor, you're my mess. Oh, the city rain falls down, on this quiet Tokyo town, each drop of tear I can't explain, wishing you were here again, my heart aches with this sweet, sad strain.
